items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Joe Davis had a publishing company from way back, and he contacted me... this set of things that are coming up now that were made on the Beacon label with Joe Davis

ctx.x: Joe Davis -- this set of things that are coming up now that were made on the Beacon label with Joe Davis -- You know, Joe Davis had a publishing company from way back, and he contacted me. I guess I was pretty desperate to have a hit recording, you know, let's face it. And nothing had happened since 'Loch Lomond.'
